llm_summary: The Skills and Certification Platform is a virtual learning management system that complements the physical learning experience in educational institutions. It provides a complete suite of services, such as the creation of institutions, teaching and learning standards, and certification offerings. By using advanced technology, it helps to streamline "the learning process" and empower both students and teachers "in their pursuit of know and skill development.

name: Oobee
project_description: Oobee (formerly known as Purple A11y) is a customisable, automated accessibility testing tool that allows software development teams to find and fix accessibility problems, to improve access to digital services for the elderly and Persons with Disabilities (PWDs).
llm_summary: The company develops a tool called Oobee to help developers test their software for accessibility features. It's also called an accessibility testing tool because it uses machine learning to predict problems that are hidden in older and disabled people's code.

name: Open Contracting Portal
project_description: The Open Contracting Portal (OC Portal) is an open-source platform built to organize and archive procurement documents, improve data transparency and feedback by the public, and help publish procurement information in the Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS)
llm_summary: An open-source project designed to organize, archive, and publish procurement documents. Its goal is to improve the transparency and accountability in the contracting process by making it easier for the public to understand and participate in government contracts.

name: Open Data Editor
project_description: Open Data Editor (ODE) is a free, open-source desktop app designed to help nonprofits, data journalists, activists, and public servants detect errors in their datasets. It is designed for people working with tabular data (Excel, Google Sheets, CSV) who don't know how to code.
llm_summary: This tutorial describes and describes Open Data Editor, a free and open-source application that helps people make sense of data. It is especially good for people who want to help with datasets but don't know code.

name: Open Health Stack
project_description: Open Health Stack provides building blocks for creating next-gen digital health apps. These open source components save time and make it easier to adopt modern healthcare standards, leading to secure, offline-capable, data-driven solutions for healthcare workers in low-resource settings.
llm_summary: The Open Health Stack provides a set of building blocks to create next-gen "digital health apps." Its open source components make it easier for anyone to implement modern healthcare standards and make it more secure.

name: Open Supply Hub
project_description: Open Supply Hub is a non-profit powering the transition to safe and sustainable production with the worldƒ??s most complete, open and accessible global supply chain map.
llm_summary: In this short video, Open Supply Hub demonstrates the value of its mission to create a more open and accessible supply chain. Its goal is to empower producers to make the transition to a safe and sustainable future by providing them with the world's most complete resource for understanding and managing their supply chain

name: Open Sustainable Technology
project_description: A directory and analysis of the open source ecosystem in the areas of climate change, sustainable energy, biodiversity and natural resources.
llm_summary: Shmoop makes a systematic analysis of the Open Source ecosystem and its effects on climate change, energy, biodiversity, and natural resources using examples from science and industry

name: Open-Pryv.io
project_description: Personal Data & Privacy Management Software, A ready-to-use solution for personal data and consent management.Pryv.io is a solid foundation on which you build your own digital health solution, so you can collect, store, share and rightfully use personal data.
llm_summary: Pryvio is a complete solution for "personal data and privacy management software." It's the perfect starting point for anyone who wants to build their own "digital health" solution.

name: OpenCRVS
project_description: OpenCRVS is a user-friendly, open-source platform designed to make civil registration accessible and effective for everyone. It supports the complete process of registering vital events, such as births and deaths, while ensuring offline functionality for remote areas, robust data security, and adherence to global CRVS standards. Tailored for low- and middle-income countries, OpenCRVS is user-centric, inclusive, and enables governments to provide legal identity for all, improve access to essential services, and generate vital statistics for policy-making.
llm_summary: the authors describe OpenCRVS, a new open-source project that helps make civil registration easier and more accessible for everyone. They focus on making civil registries more user-friendly and effective for developing countries and rural areas.

name: OpenELIS Global
project_description: OpenELIS Global is open enterprise-level laboratory information system software tailored for public health laboratories. OpenELIS is used at a national scale in a variety of settings, from small general hospital labs, all the way up to national reference labs, and all sizes in between.
llm_summary: Openelis Global is an open source laboratory information management system software designed for public health labs. Its goal is to make testing easier and more reliable. It has been proven successful in a number of different settings and at a variety of sizes

name: OpenEyes
project_description: OpenEyes is the leading open source electronic patient record (EPR) for ophthalmology. It has been designed by clinicians to be fast in delivering content, fast to navigate and easy (and fun) to use.
llm_summary: Open is the open source, community-supported, and maintained ophthalmology eMR is the most complete and up-to-datable medical record of all.

name: OpenFn
project_description: OpenFn is a workflow automation platform that's used to automate & integrate critical business processes and systems. From last-mile services to national-level reporting, it boosts efficiency & effectiveness while enabling secure, stable, scalable interoperability at all levels.
llm_summary: The company describes its new workflow automation platform, OpenFn, as a "critical business process and systems" that can help enterprises manage their IT infrastructure. It boosts efficiency and effectiveness while enabling interoperability at multiple levels.

name: OpenMRS
project_description: OpenMRS is a collaborative open-source project to develop software to support the delivery of health care in developing countries. OpenMRS is founded on the principles of openness and sharing of ideas, software and strategies for deployment and use.
llm_summary: In this short paper, Dr. Barlow explains the intent of OpenMRS, a project to develop open-source software to aid in the delivery of quality health care in poor countries. He emphasizes the importance of information sharing and the value of experimentation in order to gain insights from experience.

name: OpenRIMS
project_description: OpenRIMS is a web-based tool that helps NMRAs streamline and track medicines registration to ensure that they have the most updated medicines available and approved for prescribing and use.
llm_summary: OpenRimss is a Web-based tool to help manufacturers register their medicines with the FDA. It helps manufacturers manage their inventory and make sure they have the latest and updated medicines available.

name: OpenRIMS-PV
project_description: OpenRIMS-PV is a web-based application used by clinicians, regulatory bodies, and implementing partners to actively monitor the safety of medicines. It is part of the OpenRIMS suite (openrims.org).
llm_summary: Clinicians can monitor drug safety using OpenRims-PV, a web-enabled application used by pharmacists and regulatory authorities to help them understand the risks and benefits of medicines.

name: OpenSPP
project_description: OpenSPP is an integrated and digital social protection information system that enables governments and humanitarian agencies to streamline the creation and management of assistance programs.
llm_summary: OpenSPP, a new generation of information systems that helps governments, aid agencies, and private companies, to more easily manage and track their activities.

name: OpenSRP
project_description: Open source mobile health platform that allows frontline health workers to electronically register and track the health of their entire client population.
llm_summary: Front-line health information can be tracked using a mobile health platform.

name: Penpot
project_description: Penpot is the first open-source design and prototyping platform that enables true collaboration between designers and developers. Built on web standards (SVG, CSS, HTML), it provides professional design tools without vendor lock-in, available as cloud service or self-hosted.
llm_summary: Pen is an open source design platform that supports Web standards and allows designers and developers to work together.

name: Pol.is
project_description: Polis is a real-time system for gathering, analyzing, and understanding what large groups of people think in their own words, enabled by advanced statistics and machine learning. Polis has been used all over the world by governments, academics, independent media, and citizens.
llm_summary: Polis a system for learning, understanding, and storing information about people

name: PRISM
project_description: PRISM is a climate risk monitoring system that integrates geospatial data on hazards such as droughts, floods, tropical storms, and earthquakes, along with information on socioeconomic vulnerability, to inform disaster risk reduction and social assistance programmes.
llm_summary: PRISM is an acronym for Meteorological and Signals Systems, Inc. and the name of the company. It stands for Microwave and the initials of the science and the company are a reference to the first letter of the name. PRISM means "risk" in Latin so far. The whole family of countries uses the system to keep track of changes in the world's weather.

name: Project AEDES
project_description: Project AEDES, by CirroLytix is a tool that correlates dengue cases and deaths with real-time data from climate, google searches, and remote sensing, to predict potential dengue hotspot locations.
llm_summary: Project Aedes is an effort to use artificial intelligence to predict the future effects of aedesa, a local venereal disease

name: QField
project_description: Survey and digitize data in the field with seamless synchronization.QField focuses on efficiently getting GIS fieldwork done and exchanging data between the field and the office in a comfortable and user-friendly way.
llm_summary: The goal of this workshop is to reduce the time and cost of doing GIS work in the field by streamlining the process and making it more user-friendly. The idea is to get the most out of your data by automating its collection and sending it back to the office. In order to do this, you should use a combination of XML and CSV files. For example, they have created a tool called "Seed Field" that allows you to send data back and forth between your office and the field with ease.

name: Querido Di?­rio
project_description: Querido Di?­rio is an open-source toolkit that enables the analysis, manipulation, and centralization of official data extracted from journals published by cities. It also makes this data accessible to everyone in a single platform through a standardized visual interface and a public API.
llm_summary: Querido di iorio  engine.Databases in this engine are stored in a single place, with a single view and a single API.

name: Rahat
project_description: Rahat is a collection of open-source, blockchain-powered projects for cash and aid distribution and management. It enables the efficient and transparent coordination of resources and relief efforts. By leveraging token-based transfers, Rahat supports anticipatory cash and voucher
llm_summary: Using blockchain technology to manage distribution of funds and goods during disasters, Rahat develops a collection of projects designed to support "the efficient and transparent Coordinated Supply Chain Management for Cash and Aid Distribution and Management.

name: Register for Organic Agriculture
project_description: ROA is an innovative software tool designed to simplify the record-keeping process for farmers and agribusinesses, ensuring compliance with organic standards and EU Regulation 2018/848 for organic agriculture.
llm_summary: Roa is an agricultural record-keeping software tool that helps businesses keep track of their organic acres and ensure compliance with EU regulations.

name: Rural Environmental Registry Registration Module
project_description: The Rural Environmental Registry (RER) is a solution for managing declared geospatial environmental information on rural properties to serve as a database for control, monitoring, environmental and economic planning.
llm_summary: Rivers publishes a Geographic information on land use and uses it as a resource for planning and control. The goal of the registry is to create a single source of information for all aspects of the environment affecting rural America

name: Safe YOU
project_description: Safe YOU is an innovative technological solution created to reduce gender-based violence through a mobile application and multifunctional web platform which work to streamline prevention programmes and ensure safety and access to resources for all women and girls.
llm_summary: Safe You is an innovative technology solution that helps reduce gender- based violence by providing women with information about how to prevent and report incidents of violence

name: SanteSuite
project_description: SanteSuite (SanteIMS & SanteMPI) is an essential suite of products for national digital health infrastructure components that leverages a unique identity to facilitate data consolidation, harmonization, sharing, and building health information exchanges (e.g., OpenHIE) to establish interoperability across multiple software solutions.SanteIMS - is an immunization management system and EIR platform that supports the management of any type and scale of vaccination program including pandemic response, such as COVID-19 vaccination.SanteMPI - Master Patient Index/Client Registry (MPI/CR) platform designed to overcome barriers to leveraging person-centered data as a catalyst for transforming health systems.
llm_summary: Sante Suite is a suite of products that helps to manage and share information across the entire health system. It includes: immunization management systems and EIR platforms such as SanteIMS for disease control and pandemic response; vaccination management tools such as SutteSuite for managing large vaccination programs; and a Master Patient Index and Client Registry (MPi/CR) Platform designed to overcome "barriers to leveraging personcentered data as an a catalyst for transformation health systems".

name: SimpleAudit
project_description: Lightweight AI safety auditing framework for red-teaming AI systems through adversarial probing. Supports multilingual testing across safety, healthcare, and RAG scenarios. Works with cloud APIs or fully local models.
llm_summary: This framework is a lightweight AI safety audit and testing framework that enables enterprises to test their AI systems against each other. It can be used for many different uses, including: safety, medicine, and research

name: Statbus
project_description: Statbus is a web application for statistical offices, assisting and enabling them to build and maintain a business register that is the backbone for national accounts and economic statistics.
llm_summary: The statistical office uses a web application called Statbus to manage their business register, which is the "backbone for national accounting and economic statistics".Statbus helps statisticians build and maintain an accurate business register.

name: Sunbird RC
project_description: ƒ??Sunbird Registry and Credentialƒ? or simply ƒ??Sunbird RCƒ? is an open source software to rapidly build and deploy next generation electronic registries and verifiable credentials including attestation and verification flows.
llm_summary: The Sunbird registry and credential manager, or simply Sunbird RC as it is called, is an open-source software that allows developers to build and deploy "next generation Electronic Registries and Verifiable Credential Management Systems" using a single line of code.

name: Sunbird Saral
project_description: Sunbird Saral has been conceptualized to enable users to create structured digital information from a physical form. Saral works as a solution that can phygitize data on physical printed sheets and upload the data onto a back end in a structured format via a scan.
llm_summary: Sun Saral is a solution to create "structured" physical data from physical data on a computer.

name: Sunbird SERVE
project_description: Sunbird SERVE building block can enable efficient volunteer interactions that add significant value to society and overall human development. It enables relevant actors to crowdsource volunteers for their needs and participate in interactions like nominate, approve, promote, acknowledge, recognition, toward the realisation of the value
llm_summary: Crowdsourcing and volunteerism in the Sunbird community is a great idea because it allows people to share their own experiences and needs and encourages others to join in. For example, in order to make a donation to the Red Cross, people might say, "I want to help the poor" and "I hate hospitals." Instead, they might be more interested in helping the poor by volunteering to work on projects that directly benefit them.

name: Surveillance Outbreak Response Management and Analysis System
project_description: SORMAS is an open source mobile and web-based eHealth software for organizing and facilitating disease control, outbreak management procedures, disease surveillance, and epidemiological analysis for all administrative levels of the public health system. SORMAS aims to improve prevention, early detection and control of communicable diseases. SORMAS adheres to the highest data protection standards, good scientific practice, and open access policy.
llm_summary: SorMAS is an eHealth software designed to help implement disease control and prevention strategies for the public system. It helps to reduce communicable disease outbreaks by organizing and coordinating disease control activities at all levels of the health system.

name: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server
project_description: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server is an open Linux operating system that is secure and adaptable for long-term support and innovation-ready infrastructure running business-critical workloads on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge.
llm_summary: S, an open source operating system designed by SUSE. Its primary claim is to be a good foundation for any enterprise that depends on it.

name: Synthea
project_description: Synthea is an open-source synthetic patient generator that models the medical history of synthetic patients and produces synthetic health data free from cost, privacy, and security restrictions.
llm_summary: Synthea, a company, uses artificial intelligence to predict the future. The company's goal is to produce "synthea" medical data in a completely free and open way.

name: The Turing Way
project_description: The Turing Way is an open source, open collaboration and community-driven guide on data science. We involve an internal open science community in creating and sharing best practices for open, reproducible, ethical and collaborative data science.
llm_summary: Turing Way is an effort to make data science more accessible and useful. We've got a GitHub page, an open source repository, and a community guide on how to use data science to help people do better work.

name: The Ushahidi Platform
project_description: The Ushahidi Platform is an integrated data crowdsourcing and mapping tool that allows people to rapidly collect, manage and analyze crowdsourced information from their communities. Empowering communities to thrive as a result of accessible data and technology.
llm_summary: Ushahidi creates an "in-depth data crowdsourcing platform" that helps people understand and manage their communities using crowdsourced information. It's a bit like Map-It, but better.

name: TradeTrust
project_description: TradeTrust is an open-source software that digitizes international trade documents, reducing paperwork, documentation costs, and the risks of fraud. TradeTrust enables the industry to verify a documentƒ??s authenticity and create Electronic Transferable Records (ETRs).
llm_summary: Trade is an open source software that verifies the authenticity of trade documents

name: TYPO3
project_description: TYPO3 is a powerful, open-source CMS backed by a vibrant professional community and commercial ecosystem. Built for enterprise, it fulfills the security and service needs of a modern business, while its feature-rich core delivers across sectors, industries, and organizations.
llm_summary: TYPO3 CMS. This CMS is the kind of CMS that Adobe wants, and lots of it. The community has built it into a complete suite of applications for enterprise customers, and we've even made a nice set of tools for it.

name: Uli
project_description: Uli is a browser plugin that provides tools for relief collective response to online gendered abuse. It is backed by open datasets of slurs and an ML model for redaction of gendered abuse in Indian languages.
llm_summary: In this short paper, Uli discusses the design of a new browser plugin called Uli. It helps to reduce the impact of online "gendered abuse" by providing a means for people to report and respond to online sexual violence against women.

name: UPYOG
project_description: The Urban Platform for DeliverY of Online Governance (UPYOG) is a set of Open APIs, services, and reference implementations, setup as a public good, to allow government entities, businesses, startups, and civil society to use a unique digital Infrastructure and build solutions at a large scale. Developed under the National Urban Digital Mission, MoHUA to facilitate the digital delivery of G2G, G2C, G2B services focussing on citizen centricity, UPYOG is available with customizable 14 reference modules.
llm_summary: UPYOG is an open source project that helps build a citywide "digital infrastructure" for online governance. It consists of a set of APIs, services and reference implementations. The purpose of the project is to make it easier for government, businesses, individuals, and the private sector to use a single digital infrastructure to build solutions on an urban scale.

name: UrbanPy
project_description: A library to download, process and visualize high resolution urban data in an easy and fast way. It also estimates and visualizes urban service accessibility, i.e. how long it takes to reach a bank, grocery store, public park, hospital, etc., from every location in a city.
llm_summary: The City Data Library is a city-wide app that helps people visualize and analyze urban data. It includes information about the time it takes to get to a specific place in a city and provides estimates of urban service availability based on available data.

name: Uwazi
project_description: Uwazi is an open-source web-based database application designed for human rights defenders to manage collections of information, including documents, evidence, cases and complaints.
llm_summary: The Human Rights Databases Application for Uwazi is a web-based application that helps human rights defenders manage their information collection and analysis. It is free and open-source.

name: Vxnaid
project_description: Vxnaid is a digital platform that supports correct vaccine administration & efficient vaccination campaigns. Enable broad adoption of Vxnaid especially in RLS countries to ensure correct administration of vaccines, identification of vaccinees, follow-up/recall of vaccinated persons and understanding of vaccination campaign effectiveness.
llm_summary: The company describes its new Vaccination Campaign Management System called "Vxnai" and explains how it helps to support effective vaccination campaigns in low-income countries. It includes a lot of machine learning to help make sure that all the people get vaccinated and that they get sick people who need to be vaccinated.

name: WSO2 Identity Server
project_description: WSO2 Identity Server is an open-source Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution supporting secure authentication, identity federation, and user management via open standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM 2.0, and FIDO2.
llm_summary: This WSO2.IO product describes an enterprise-class identity management and secure authentication system that leverages open source technologies such as OpenID, OpenID Connection, SAML Secure Authentication Protocol, FIDO 2.0 and OAuth2.0. It provides secure authentication, federation, and management of multiple identities using a single IAM solution.

name: Zamba
project_description: AI tools for wildlife monitoring with camera trap videos. Zamba is a command-line tool built in Python to automatically identify the species seen in camera trap videos from sites in central Africa. The tool makes predictions for 24 common species in these videos.
llm_summary: Zamba is an artificial intelligence tool that uses machine learning to predict the African wildlife seen in camera-tracked video. It uses Python to identify and track down specific animals
